title: SEC6/decision: String keys in take_vars remove Box::leak without UAF risk
description: In crates/kithd/src/config.rs, take_vars/restore_vars (lines 190-209) changed the key type from &'static str (which required Box::leak to extend the lifetime of dynamically constructed strings to 'static) to owned String. The change is safe because: the Vec<(String, Option<String>)> is kept alive by the caller for the full scope of the test, so the String keys are never used after the Vec drops, and restore_vars consumes the Vec by value. No unsafe lifetime extension is needed. Box::leak was previously used as a workaround for the 'static bound on set_var/remove_var; with owned Strings passed directly to env::set_var/remove_var (which accept AsRef<OsStr>), there is no 'static requirement to satisfy.
